result.instructions: Tools for LearnUpon, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which learners are enrolled in the course 'Onboarding basics' and how far have they got?"; "Find the user anna@example.com and show their enrollments."; "Enroll jordan@example.com in the course 'Security awareness' with a due date of 2027-03-31.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LearnUpon data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run learnupon_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run learnupon_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run learnupon_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. learnupon_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: learnupon_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the portal, 500 per page. Check pagination.has_next_page and request the next page for more. LearnUpon API: GET /users.

login_enabled.description: true = enabled users only; false = disabled users only.

tools.name: learnupon_find_user
tools.title: Find a user
tools.description: Find one user by email or username. Give one of the two. LearnUpon API: GET /users/search?email= or ?username=.

email.description: User email (a unique identifier in LearnUpon).

username.description: Username (the other unique identifier in LearnUpon).

tools.name: learnupon_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by numeric user id. LearnUpon API: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: learnupon_list_custom_user_data_fields
tools.title: List custom user data fields
tools.description: List the custom user data field definitions of the portal (their labels and types). It returns definitions, not values. LearnUpon API: GET /users/customuserdata.

tools.name: learnupon_search_courses
tools.title: Search courses
tools.description: Search courses by name (pattern match, case-insensitive) or by course_id. Returns published courses unless include_draft is true. LearnUpon API: GET /courses.

name.description: Course name or part of it.

include_all_versions.description: With name: also return archived versions.

tools.name: learnupon_search_enrollments
tools.title: Search enrollments
tools.description: Find enrollments by user (user_id, email or username) or by course (course_id or course_name). Give at least one of these. Optional date_from and date_to filter on the enrollment's updated_at date. LearnUpon API: GET /enrollments/search.

email.description: User email (a unique identifier in LearnUpon).

username.description: Username (the other unique identifier in LearnUpon).

course_name.description: Exact course title (the most recent published title).

tools.name: learnupon_get_enrollment
tools.title: Get an enrollment
tools.description: Get one enrollment by its enrollment_id, with status, progress and dates. LearnUpon API: GET /enrollments/{enrollment_id}.

tools.name: learnupon_get_enrollment_modules
tools.title: List modules of an enrollment
tools.description: List the modules of one enrollment, with the learner's progress on each. LearnUpon API: GET /enrollments/{enrollment_id}/modules.

tools.name: learnupon_list_markcompletes
tools.title: List completions
tools.description: List mark-complete records: completions set by an admin or by the API (status completed, passed or failed, score, date). Filter by id, user_id, enrollment_id or course_id. LearnUpon API: GET /markcompletes.

tools.name: learnupon_enroll_user
tools.title: Enroll a user in a course
tools.description: Enroll one user in one course, so the learner gets access and the course appears in their list. Give the user (email or username) and the course (course_id or course_name). Optional due_date (advisory) and expires_at (hard end of access), both YYYY-MM-DD. Sends no invitation email by itself. LearnUpon API: POST /enrollments.

email.description: User email (a unique identifier in LearnUpon).

username.description: Username (the other unique identifier in LearnUpon).

course_name.description: Exact course title (the most recent published title).

expires_at.description: Access end date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). The learner loses access after it.

re_enroll_if_completed.description: true = enroll again even if the learner completed the course.

annotations.title: Enroll a user in a course
